name: Noboribetsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Noboribetsu city emblem in yellow: a broken ring with a stylised arrow pointing upward.
history: Municipal flag of Noboribetsu, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1961.

features.role: Noboribetsu city emblem — a broken ring with a stylised arrow pointing upward
